subject: Data Engineering
title: The Five Pillars of Observability
description: A 60-second lesson on The Five Pillars of Observability.

hook.text: Five signals tell you if your data is healthy: freshness, volume, schema, distribution, and lineage.

buildup.text: Freshness: is the data up to date? Volume: did the expected number of rows arrive?

discovery.text: Schema: did any columns change? Distribution: do values look normal? Lineage: what's upstream and downstream?

twist.text: Any single pillar can look fine while another screams. Volume is correct but values are all zeros.

climax.text: Monitoring all five pillars gives a complete picture. Monitoring just one gives a false sense of safety.

punchline.text: Five pillars. All five matter. Check them all.

quiz.question: Which is NOT one of the five pillars of data observability?
